text:
A force acts on an area to produce a pressure.
Which changes produce the same pressure?
A
doubling the area and doubling the force
B
doubling the area and halving the force
C
doubling the area and making the force four times bigger
D
halving the area and doubling the force

options.label: A
options.text: doubling the area and doubling the force

options.label: B
options.text: doubling the area and halving the force

options.label: C
options.text: doubling the area and making the force four times bigger

options.label: D
options.text: halving the area and doubling the force
